description: This source file implements the GroovyEventHandler class, which handles web events by executing Groovy scripts within the OFBiz framework. It manages transaction boundaries, constructs script execution contexts with request/session data, and processes script results to determine the response flow.

classes.name: GroovyEventHandler
classes.description: The GroovyEventHandler class handles web events by executing specified Groovy scripts within the OFBiz framework, managing transaction boundaries and context data for script execution.
